code: # colocboost example set.seed(1) N <- 1000 P <- 100 # Generate X with LD structure sigma <- 0.9^abs(outer(1:P, 1:P, "-")) X <- MASS::mvrnorm(N, rep(0, P), sigma) colnames(X) <- paste0("SNP", 1:P) L <- 3 true_beta <- matrix(0, P, L) true_beta[10, 1] <- 0.5 # SNP10 affects trait 1 true_beta[10, 2] <- 0.4 # SNP10 also affects trait 2 (colocalized) true_beta[50, 2] <- 0.3 # SNP50 only affects trait 2 true_beta[80, 3] <- 0.6 # SNP80 only affects trait 3 Y <- matrix(0, N, L) for (l in 1:L) {   Y[, l] <- X %*% true_beta[, l] + rnorm(N, 0, 1) } res <- colocboost(X = X, Y = Y) #> Validating input data. #> Starting gradient boosting algorithm. #> Gradient boosting for outcome 1 converged after 98 iterations! #> Gradient boosting for outcome 3 converged after 106 iterations! #> Gradient boosting for outcome 2 converged after 107 iterations! #> Performing inference on colocalization events. res$cos_details$cos$cos_index #> $`cos1:y1_y2` #> [1] 10  9 #>
